title: For The Win beta
text:
AoPS For the Win beta is a game on AoPS that functions almost like the old For The Win. It was made in response to the deactivation of Adobe Flash player which was required on the old FTW. For the win beta will not include countdown rounds and a chat box but there are some new features. Here are some of them:

1.A new interface and an upgraded design.

2.Updated ranking systems that will have brand-new rank icons.

3.Everyone will start with the same rating.

For The Win beta was released on January 4, 2021.

Chat and countdown may possibly be added later on but it will be a while before that will happen.

Start testing FTW beta here. You may also report any bugs here. Note you have to be a user on AoPS to report a bug.
